versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Convert MySQL CREATE TABLE statements to Go structs
- Maps MySQL column types to Go types, including handling of unsigned and nullable types
- Converts snake_case column names to CamelCase Go field names, preserving common acronyms
- Automatically generates form, json, and xorm tags for each struct field
- Supports key xorm tag constraints: pk, autoincr, unique, not null, defaults, comments, and index
- Uses table comments as Go struct comments for improved code documentation
